text:
Looking at this problem, I need to find what day of the week it will be 521 days after Wednesday, February 13, 2002.

Since days of the week repeat every 7 days, I can use modular arithmetic:

521 ÷ 7 = 74 remainder 3

So 521 days = 74 complete weeks + 3 extra days

Starting from Wednesday and counting forward 3 days:
- Wednesday + 1 day = Thursday
- Wednesday + 2 days = Friday
- Wednesday + 3 days = Saturday

**Saturday**
